type WdgM_ConfigType [SWS_WdgM_00355]

This structure contains all post - build configurable parameters of the Watchdog Manager. A pointer to this structure is passed to the Watchdog Manager initialization function for configuration. AUTOSAR CP R20 - of D ocument ID : AUTOSAR_SWS_WatchdogManager
type WdgM_SupervisedEntityIdType [SWS_WdgM_00356]
This type identifies an individual Supervised Entity for the Watchdog Manager.
type WdgM_CheckpointIdType [SWS_WdgM_00357]

This type identifies a Checkpoint in the context of a Supervised Entity for the Watchdog Manager. Note that an individual Checkpoint can only be identified by the pair of Supervised Entity ID and Checkpoint ID.
type WdgM_Mode [SWS_WdgM_00334]

The category of Mode Declaration Group Wdg M_ Mode is EXPLICIT_ ORDER, The attribute value for the Mode Declaration are set as following: "SUPERVISION_ OK" = 0 "SUPERVISION_ FAILED" = 1 "SUPERVISION_ EXPIRED" = 2 "SUPERVISION_ STOPPED" = 3 "SUP ERVISION_ DEACTIVATED" = 4 The on Transition Value is defined as 255
type WdgM_LocalStatusType [SWS_WdgM_00359]
This type shall be used for variables that represent the current status of supervision for individual Supervised Entitie s.
type WdgM_GlobalStatusType [SWS_WdgM_00360]
This type shall be used for variables that represent the global supervision status of the Watchdog Manager module.
type WdgM_ModeType [SWS_WdgM_00358]
This type distinguishes the different modes that were configured for the Watchdog Manager.
